thread:
incident-bot: URGENT: PAGER — GCP us-west1 GPU quota limit hit. Autoscaler attempts failing. Queues rising in prod inference. Severity: P1. :rotating_light:
priya (oncall): ack. what's the immediate customer impact?
maya (sre): alert: prod-inference.queue.us-west1 > 900. p95 latency for chat-gen at ~22s. spike in 502/504 from edge when router queues overflow.
jorge (infra): cloud API errors show 'QUOTA_EXCEEDED' on accelerator create. current allocated GPUs = 34, quota = 34. autoscaler requested +8 GPUs and got denied. Attempted retries logged.
rachel (support): triaging customers: three high-throughput tenants show timeouts on batch jobs. Raising status notices.
priya (oncall): can we divert work to warm standbys? are model shards available elsewhere?
jorge (infra): warm pools: us-west2 has 12 free GPUs in warm pool but not populated with latest model shards — can do quick load. us-central1 has minimal spare. Spilling will incur cold-start delay ~45s-2m.
maya (sre): mitigation options coming:
1) model-shedding: drop to lighter model variant for new sessions (saves ~30-40% GPU per replica)
2) prioritize traffic: VIP customers only, throttle anonymous/dev orgs at edge
3) borrow from dedicated-reserved pool in us-west1 (requires routing weight change)
4) manual reclamation: find noncritical jobs consuming GPUs and ask owners to preempt

priya (oncall): pick a path. prioritize customers. enable model-shedding and throttle dev orgs.
deploy-bot: runbook step triggered: apply-rate-limit -channel=prod-edge -policy=throttle-low-priority -threshold=50rps
jorge (infra): applying routing weight change to shift 8% of production traffic to dedicated-reserved pool. Also filing GCP support case: case# 220-444-900. They estimate 3-5h review.
batch-team: FYI we have a scheduled data-parallel job still running in us-west1 using 6 GPUs (job id: batch-774). Can pause if needed.
priya (oncall): ask batch-team to scale down noncritical batch now. Do it safely.
batch-team: acknowledged. scaling down batch-774 by 4 GPUs, reclaim ETA 90s.
maya (sre): as soon as model-shedding toggled, we should see queue drain. Need approval for automated fallback for new sessions only.
priya (oncall): approved. proceed.
deploy-bot: config.patch: {
  "service": "prod-inference-us-west1",
  "policy": { "session_fallback": ["redwood-medium-q8","redwood-small-q8"], "apply_to_new_sessions": true }
}

maya (sre): rollout started. watch metrics.
jorge (infra): inventory check: `gcloud compute instances list --filter="zone:(us-west1*) AND status=RUNNING" --project=redwood-prod` -> found a legacy analytics cluster still active. contacting owner.
rachel (support): status page update drafted: "We are investigating increased latency for inference in GCP us-west1. Engineers are performing mitigations; some customers may experience degraded performance. More updates every 30m." publishing now.
maya (sre): after model-shedding and batch reclaim, queue dropped 900 -> 260 within 4m. p95 from 22s -> 5.8s. error rate reduced significantly.
jorge (infra): we were able to reassign two reserved GPUs from the dedicated pool to prod, which helped top-priority traffic. Note: doing this reduces capacity for dedicated customers; informed account managers.
priya (oncall): good. any remaining blocked workloads?
rachel (support): batch tenant C-9971 still impacted for sustained high-throughput pipelines; offering workaround to switch to smaller shard size or pause jobs.
maya (sre): next steps:
- keep throttles for anonymous/dev orgs until queue < 100 for 30m
- continue communication with GCP case# 220-444-900; escalate to urgent if ETA slips beyond 2h
- post-incident: update autoscaler to surface quota-exceeded as a dedicated alert and add automatic fallback runbook entries

priya (oncall): I'm paging cloud-ops to review other projects for unexpected GPU usage. jorge, can you run quick inventory for orphaned VMs?
jorge (infra): running: `gcloud compute instances list --project=redwood-prod --filter="labels.owned!=true"` -> found 3 instances tagged 'temp-ml-test' consuming 3 GPUs. emailing owners to terminate.
maya (sre): added temporary alert: if scaleup_attempts_fail > 3 in 10m AND queue > 200 -> page SRE oncall. ticket SRE-441 created.
priya (oncall): handing incident to SRE follow-up. I'll stay assigned as incident lead until stabilized. Posting concise incident summary for postmortem: "Cause: project-level GPU quota reached in us-west1; autoscaler requests denied causing scale stall and queue growth. Mitigations: model-shedding for new sessions, reclaimed GPUs from batch and reserved pools, throttling low-priority traffic, status page updates, GCP quota request in flight (case# 220-444-900)."
rachel (support): will send targeted notes to impacted customers with suggested workarounds (use quantized models, reduce batch sizes).
priya (oncall): closing the pager but leaving watch channel open for next 2 hours. Owner for RCA: jorge (infra). Post-incident action owner for runbook updates: maya (sre).
